policy: Reference upstream projects; adapt ideas with attribution and licence compliance; do not vendor whole trading engines without a specific engineering need.

projects.name: Freqtrade
projects.role: strategy framework, historical backtesting, dry-run forward testing, FreqAI
projects.planned_use: Compare crypto strategy lifecycle, backtest safeguards, and dry-run practices before deciding whether a separate crypto engine is justified.
constraints: GPL obligations must be reviewed before copying or linking code

projects.name: Freqtrade strategies
projects.license: GPL-3.0 (verify upstream repository at time of reuse)
projects.planned_use: Treat strategies as hypotheses; port individual rules only after checking their source, licence, look-ahead risks, and independent performance.
constraints: examples are not proof of profitability

projects.name: NautilusTrader
projects.role: event-driven multi-asset backtesting and execution architecture
projects.planned_use: Study fill models, time handling, portfolio accounting, and backtest/live parity; avoid adding its heavier stack to the 4 GB laptop until needed.
constraints: live execution has failure modes that backtests do not reproduce

projects.name: LEAN
projects.planned_use: Study portfolio accounting, corporate-action handling, and multi-market abstraction before considering an engine migration.
constraints: data and broker availability depend on provider
full engine may be excessive for current hardware and scope

projects.name: Microsoft Qlib
projects.role: quantitative research workflows, model evaluation and experiment tracking
projects.planned_use: Use its workflow concepts to separate feature creation, train/validation/test windows, predictions, and portfolio evaluation.
constraints: research framework rather than a turnkey broker-connected bot
market data and model quality determine results

projects.name: FinRL
projects.planned_use: Read the research/evaluation methodology; defer RL until simpler baselines are robust and sufficient training data exists.
constraints: compute-intensive experimentation can be unsuitable for 4 GB RAM
training reward is not evidence of future profitability

projects.name: CCXT
projects.planned_use: Evaluate as a data/exchange adapter only after selecting a supported venue and verifying API terms, rate limits, and India access.
constraints: does not provide a profitable strategy
venue-specific capabilities and data quality vary

projects.name: LightGBM
projects.planned_use: Keep the current model as a candidate and require walk-forward, purged-label, cost-stress, and out-of-sample comparisons against simple baselines.
constraints: not a trading bot by itself
current model only covers the existing Indian-equity research dataset

evaluation_rules: Use the same time range, assets, data quality rules, initial capital, fees, slippage, and fill assumptions when comparing strategies.
Never select a strategy solely by its best backtest return.
Report net return, benchmark excess return, maximum drawdown, trade count, turnover, exposure, and risk-adjusted metrics.
Use chronological walk-forward evaluation with training labels fully matured before each test decision.
Preserve a final untouched test period; do not tune on it.
Paper-trade candidates separately before promotion; never auto-promote research candidates.
Keep crypto, forex, and Indian equities in separate portfolios, data adapters, session rules, cost models, and risk limits.
Keep all execution paper-only; no live broker integration or leverage in this research phase.
